Note: Unmatched Labs health dial. MeshURL and DiffuseURL are filled in on export; the mesh is the fixed two-sided dial and the diffuse is its complete 1:2 skin atlas.

ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Model
ObjectStates.Description: Click < or > to change the health. Click RESET, or alt-click either arrow, to return to full health.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--[[
  Health dial — Unmatched Labs.

  The fixed model has a portrait disc, a counter body, and a reset tab. The
  value and arrows are TTS button labels placed over the counter body; RESET is
  placed over its own tab. Their separate transparent hit targets are larger
  than the visible controls, without overlapping the value in the middle.

  Two TTS behaviours are deliberately preserved here:

  1. A transparent button background does not draw its label. Hit targets
     therefore have no label; each visible label is a separate zero-sized
     button with an opaque colour.
  2. Do not call self.clearButtons() inside draw. Clearing and recreating in the
     same frame can remove the newly-created controls along with the old ones.

  The CONFIG table is rewritten by the exporter. Keep each entry a plain scalar
  on its own line and keep the closing brace in the first column.
]]

CONFIG = {
    MIN_VALUE = 0,
    MAX_VALUE = 20,
    VALUE = 20,
    NUMBER_SIZE = 600,
    TRIGGER_SIZE = 450,
    RESET_SIZE = 110,
    INK = "ffffff",
    PLATE = "1a1a1a",
    SHOW_TOOLTIP = true,
}

local PER_INCH = 700

local VALUE_X = 0
local VALUE_Z = -1.6
local LOWER_X = -0.6
local LOWER_Z = -1.7
local RAISE_X = 0.6
local RAISE_Z = -1.7
local RESET_X = 0
local RESET_Z = -2.5

-- The visible triggers sit on the model; their targets extend into open table
-- space. The 0.45-wide centre gap keeps either target off the health value.
local LOWER_TARGET_X = -0.95
local RAISE_TARGET_X = 0.95
local TRIGGER_TARGET_WIDTH = 1.0
local TRIGGER_TARGET_HEIGHT = 1.2
local RESET_TARGET_WIDTH = 1.1
local RESET_TARGET_HEIGHT = 0.5

local function clamp(value)
    if value < CONFIG.MIN_VALUE then return CONFIG.MIN_VALUE end
    if value > CONFIG.MAX_VALUE then return CONFIG.MAX_VALUE end
    return value
end

local function colour(hex, alpha)
    local digits = string.gsub(hex, "#", "")
    return {
        r = tonumber(string.sub(digits, 1, 2), 16) / 255,
        g = tonumber(string.sub(digits, 3, 4), 16) / 255,
        b = tonumber(string.sub(digits, 5, 6), 16) / 255,
        a = alpha
    }
end

local function rect(wide, tall)
    return wide * PER_INCH, tall * PER_INCH
end

-- The model arrives after the object. Its exact top is 0.099467 units; the
-- bounds calculation keeps the labels useful if TTS applies a scale, while the
-- fallback still clears this mesh before its bounds are available.
local function faceY()
    local ok, bounds = pcall(function() return self.getBoundsNormalized() end)
    if ok and bounds ~= nil and bounds.size ~= nil and bounds.size.y ~= nil then
        return bounds.size.y / 2 + 0.02
    end
    return 0.12
end

local function caption()
    if CONFIG.SHOW_TOOLTIP then
        return tostring(CONFIG.VALUE) .. " of " .. tostring(CONFIG.MAX_VALUE)
    end
    return ""
end

local function hitTarget(handler, x, y, z, wide, tall, tooltip)
    local width, height = rect(wide, tall)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = handler,
        function_owner = self,
        label = "",
        tooltip = tooltip,
        position = { x, y, z },
        width = width,
        height = height,
        alignment = 3,
        color = colour(CONFIG.PLATE, 0)
    })
end

local function label(text, x, y, z, size)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "ignore",
        function_owner = self,
        label = text,
        position = { x, y, z },
        width = 0,
        height = 0,
        alignment = 3,
        font_size = size,
        font_color = colour(CONFIG.INK, 1),
        color = colour(CONFIG.PLATE, 1)
    })
end

local function show()
    -- Targets 0..2, then labels 3..6. Keep this order in draw.
    self.editButton({ index = 0, tooltip = "Lose one — " .. caption() .. " — alt-click for full" })
    self.editButton({ index = 1, tooltip = "Gain one — " .. caption() .. " — alt-click for full" })
    self.editButton({ index = 2, tooltip = "Reset to full — " .. caption() })
    self.editButton({ index = 3, label = tostring(CONFIG.VALUE) })
end

local function step(by, alt)
    if alt then
        CONFIG.VALUE = CONFIG.MAX_VALUE
    else
        CONFIG.VALUE = clamp(CONFIG.VALUE + by)
    end
    show()
end

function draw()
    local y = faceY()

    hitTarget("lower", LOWER_TARGET_X, y, LOWER_Z,
        TRIGGER_TARGET_WIDTH, TRIGGER_TARGET_HEIGHT, "Lose one")
    hitTarget("raise", RAISE_TARGET_X, y, RAISE_Z,
        TRIGGER_TARGET_WIDTH, TRIGGER_TARGET_HEIGHT, "Gain one")
    hitTarget("reset", RESET_X, y, RESET_Z,
        RESET_TARGET_WIDTH, RESET_TARGET_HEIGHT, "Reset to full")

    label(tostring(CONFIG.VALUE), VALUE_X, y, VALUE_Z, CONFIG.NUMBER_SIZE)
    label("<", LOWER_X, y, LOWER_Z, CONFIG.TRIGGER_SIZE)
    label(">", RAISE_X, y, RAISE_Z, CONFIG.TRIGGER_SIZE)
    label("RESET", RESET_X, y, RESET_Z, CONFIG.RESET_SIZE)

    show()
end

function onSave()
    return JSON.encode({ value = CONFIG.VALUE })
end

function onLoad(state)
    if state ~= nil and state ~= "" then
        local ok, saved = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(state) end)
        if ok and saved ~= nil and saved.value ~= nil then
            CONFIG.VALUE = clamp(saved.value)
        end
    end
    Wait.time(draw, 1)
end

function raise(_object, _colour, alt) step(1, alt) end

function lower(_object, _colour, alt) step(-1, alt) end

function reset() step(0, true) end

-- Label-only buttons have no clickable rectangle; this is defensive only.
function ignore() end
